I booked a full haircut for my dog. Granted, my husband dropped him off and didn’t have instruction for them other than “same as last time”; however, I put a note in when I booked online that said “keep the length of the ears and tail but trim behind the ears and his butt. When I picked him up after paying $120 behind his ears looked untouched. When I asked for a revision, the groomer said that my husband and I must have miscommunicated. I left him there for her to shave behind the ears and it looks choppy. Won’t be going back.

I have been a Petco grooming customer for the past 3 years for my dog Harper in both Florida and Dallas. I’m not sure where the disconnect is but our last two appointments haven’t had ideal results. I’ve had to bring her back across the city to clean up her haircut previously. I couldn’t do it with the most recent appointment. Her face still needs a lot of cleaning up, but I don’t have the time to keep coming back. The team is nice, but we will likely look elsewhere for our future grooming appointments.

I’m sure all fur parents want the best for their fur babies. Well, look no further. The Petco on Lovers Lane in Dallas showed my babies the most love as well as awesome service. The professionalism mixed with friendliness is the reason I highly recommend them for your fur baby. Amber gave my Miniature schnauzer the best cut she has ever had. I’ve found my salon for my 2 fur babies.

The store called to state my dog had fleas, I bathed my dog the Wednesday before coming to Dallas, there was no flea dirt on her bottom and no fleas, I clean my dog when she comes in from outside that evening and morning still no fleas my flea and tick  routine has been consistent for the three years I’ve had my dog and for this to be the first time I come to PETCO in another city and told my dog has fleas I’m over it

My appointment was at 8:30am and normally there is someone at the door to open the door and let me in since the store opens at 9am. I knocked and no one came to the door. I texted back to the reminder message to see if anyone would answer and luckily it went through; however, the groomer came to the front mad and upset that I did that and asked to not do that in the future and to ring the bell. There is no sign anywhere about the doorbell, so I wasn’t aware of the doorbell.

I picked up my dog and my dog smelled terrible. I’ve been taking my dog here for two years now and she’s never smelled as bad as she did yesterday; the haircut was also done wrong. I had to come home and give my dog a bath after I paid over $100.
